t: This is Ladbroke Square, a garden square in Notting Hill, west London, also known as Kensington Park Gardens. The name comes from James Weller Ladbroke, a nineteenth-century landowner and the principal developer of the Ladbroke Estate. Many Notting Hill streets still carry his name, including Ladbroke Grove, and the old estate is now a conservation area. So the square belongs to a wider planned neighbourhood. The writer and translator Elizabeth Lucas, who lived from 1873 to 1951, died here.
